haunches – supports highly accurate cornering.

utilising Uni-Q™ technology for the first time
in a production car.
6. STORAGE

exceptionally well thought out. It has central cup holders,
phone storage and door bins that can accommodate a
500ml bottle. Practicality also comes from the glovebox,
trinket tray ahead of the gearstick and a central stowage
area beneath the armrest between the seats with USB
and 12v ports.
7. SEATS
The seats have been designed to combine exceptional
lateral support for high-speed cornering with total
comfort for long-distance journeys.
8. LUGGAGE
Luggage or other large items can be stored behind the
seats or in the boot to the rear of the engine. This space
will take a standard-sized flight case or a set of golf
clubs. The combined luggage space is 359ltrs.
